instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph, full shot from behind of a couple walking away on a paved path near the coast. On the left, the bearded man (R2) wearing a white t-shirt and black leggings carries a red yoga mat. On the right, the woman with a shaved head (R1) wearing a white crop top and grey bike shorts carries a pink shoulder bag. They walk side-by-side with their arms wrapped around each other's backs under soft, overcast light with muted natural tones.
